summary: Tested Ad.Tasks tab redesign in ProjectDetailPage.js. All features working correctly: summary cards, filter tabs, advanced filters panel, table with all required columns, timer buttons (Start/Pause/Done), type and work_link fields in Add/Edit modal, priority indicators.

minor.issue: Backend returns all tasks regardless of project_id query param. Filtering is done client-side. Consider adding server-side filtering for performance with large datasets.

updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_adtasks_redesign.py - Created comprehensive API tests for Ad.Tasks
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed tasks during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ad.Tasks tab in ProjectDetailPage has been redesigned to match OurTasksPage design. Features: 4 summary cards (Total, Pending, In Progress, Completed), filter tabs (All, Pending, In Progress, Completed), advanced filters panel (Date, Assigned To, Type, Status), table with columns (Task, Status, Assigned, Due Date, Link, Time, Timer, Actions). Timer buttons work correctly (Start/Pause/Done). Add/Edit modal includes type dropdown (general, bug, feature, content, design) and work_link field.
